enumDescriptions: Use GitHub Copilot authentication (requires active Copilot subscription)
Bring Your Own Key – connect to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
navi.authMode.description: Authentication mode: use GitHub Copilot or bring your own API key.

navi.apiKey.markdownDescription: API Key for BYOK mode. Prefer environment variable `NAVI_API_KEY` in shared environments.

navi.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (BYOK mode only).

navi.model.description: Model name. In Copilot mode the default model is used unless overridden.

navi.streaming.description: Enable streaming session mode when creating Copilot SDK sessions. If disabled, replies are returned as complete messages.

navi.mcpEnabled.description: Enable loading tools from configured MCP servers.

navi.copilotCliPath.description: Optional explicit path to Copilot CLI executable. Use this when auto detection fails (for example, set to node_modules/@github/copilot-win32-x64/copilot.exe on Windows).

navi.debugCopilotCliArgs.description: Log the full GitHub Copilot CLI launch command and argv preview to the output channel 'Navi Copilot CLI'.

navi.debugAgentReplyFlow.description: Log the end-to-end agent reply pipeline, including session events, tool calls, deltas, fallback branches, and errors, to the output channel 'Navi Agent Flow'.

navi.debugAgentReplyFlowReveal.description: Automatically reveal the 'Navi Agent Flow' output channel whenever a reply-flow debug log is written.

scripts.compile-tests: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
